semantic_factors.factor: Lifecycle state of the previous request at the next-fetch boundary
semantic_factors.explanation: resolveA and flush jointly establish one condition. Counting them as two factors would conflate execution statements with independent semantic conditions.

exact_defect_path.evidence: Modified diagnostic false before/after; official P signals [false,false,false]. Source assigns #controller=undefined on success before future invalidate; R retains/aborts previous controller.

classification_by_granularity.feature_level: The original test does execute previous-request abort behavior. This is confirmed feature activation, not by itself formal Behavioral Masking.
classification_by_granularity.concrete_defect_path_level: Target Bypass relative to the settled-A -> cleared-controller -> next-ab path: that path is absent from the original observed A-to-ab transition.
classification_by_granularity.recommended_reporting: Primary: Context-recoverable Validation Miss. Report executed broad abort feature, absent completed-request defect path, and unestablished strict Behavioral Masking witness separately. post_success_mechanism_audit.instrumentation_limit: Supplementary test logging observes signals. Source-based branch inference is corroborated by those outputs; there is no independent line-coverage trace. Diagnostics are not substituted for uninstrumented four-cell results.
